prompt_text: Who was the king in France in 2020?
response_text: France has been a republic since the abolition of the monarchy in the late 19th century, and it has no king today. In 2020 the head of state was President **Emmanuel Macron**, who was serving his first term after being elected in 2017. The country’s government operates under a semi‑presidential system, with the president as the chief executive and a prime minister (Édouard Philippe in 2020) heading the government. So, there was no king of France in 2020.
